fields.subject: SQL Server Type Mapping
fields.trigger: a caller invokes a table-valued helper with SqlDataRecord rows, models, keyed models, or virtual compound keys containing a shard identifier
fields.response: append one Structured input parameter whose row values follow the supplied sequence and whose keyed overloads place the shard identifier before record and successive child identifiers; the model-based, keyed-model, and virtual-compound-key overloads materialize every row into a List<SqlDataRecord> before assignment, so a null or empty source always yields a null parameter Value (never System.DBNull.Value and never an empty SqlDataRecord enumeration, both of which Microsoft.Data.SqlClient rejects client-side); the raw SqlDataRecord overload instead normalizes to a null Value only when the supplied sequence is null or is an ICollection<SqlDataRecord>/IReadOnlyCollection<SqlDataRecord> whose Count is zero, and passes any other sequence through without enumerating it
fields.postcondition: the parameter name is @-prefixed and the supplied collection is returned; for the model-based, keyed-model, and virtual-compound-key overloads an empty or null source never throws and never omits the parameter, but the raw SqlDataRecord overload can still throw when passed an uncounted lazy sequence that turns out to be empty at enumeration time, since that sequence is passed to the driver unexamined
